problem.heading: Most deal presentations don't do justice to the business.
problem.prose:
A PDF sent cold. A Dropbox link with unstructured financials. A listing on a classifieds site with three lines of description. Buyers scroll past. Conversations never start.

You've done the work to represent the seller. Bottega makes sure buyers can see it.

faq.heading: FAQs
faq.a1: You tell us what you're looking for: budget, sector, how involved you want to be day to day. From there, we find matching opportunities, including ones not listed publicly, walk you through financing and due diligence, and connect you to a small group of vetted lawyers, accountants, and financing experts, often on better terms than you'd get on your own.
faq.a2: First-time buyers, solo operators and career changers looking to own a business in Portugal.
faq.q4: What kind of businesses can Bottega help me find?
faq.a4: Profitable, real-world businesses that solve an everyday need: accounting firms, HVAC, dental practices, repair shops, condo management, vending machines, light manufacturing, boutique hotels, food retail, office space. No startups, no crypto, no SaaS pitch decks. If it doesn't already make money doing something tangible, it's not a fit.
faq.a5: Bottega doesn't charge buyers. We're in early access mode, focused on creating real value before figuring out how this sustains itself. If that changes, you'll know before it does.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.s1Body: Bottega Ventures Ltd (Company number 11114051), 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, England, W1W 5PF, is the operator of this platform. We help individuals find and acquire businesses in Portugal. For privacy enquiries contact privacy@bottegaventures.com.
privacyPage.s2Body: For buyers: name, email address, budget range, sector preferences, and any other criteria you share with us. We also collect basic usage data (page views, browser type) via analytics.
privacyPage.s3Body: Your information is used to understand what you are looking for, source relevant opportunities, and follow up with you directly. We do not use your information for advertising or sell it to third parties.
privacyPage.s4Body: Your information may be shared with vetted advisors (lawyers, accountants, financing experts) where relevant to your search, and only with your knowledge. We do not share your data with third parties without your consent. We use Supabase (EU-hosted) for data storage and may use Resend for transactional email.
privacyPage.s5Body: If you are a business owner whose listing appears on Bottega, whether submitted directly or sourced from a public third-party platform, your data is handled with care. Information used to describe your business is used solely to present your business to relevant buyers. Seller contact details and sensitive information are shared only with buyers who have signed a confidentiality agreement. If you would like your data updated, contact privacy@bottegaventures.com and we will action it promptly.
privacyPage.s6Body: Buyer data is retained for 24 months from your last interaction with us. You may request deletion at any time by emailing privacy@bottegaventures.com.
privacyPage.s7Body: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You may also object to processing or request a copy of your data in a portable format. To exercise these rights, contact privacy@bottegaventures.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority.
privacyPage.s8Body: We use session cookies required for the platform to function. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising cookies. Analytics data is aggregated and not linked to individual users.
privacyPage.s9Body: These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service

Bottega helps individuals find and acquire businesses in Portugal. We are not a broker, agent, or financial advisor. We do not take success fees, hold client funds, or represent either party in a transaction.

Bottega may edit listings for clarity and presentation, but the underlying facts remain your responsibility. Do not include information that is confidential, defamatory, or legally restricted.
termsPage.s3Body: By requesting access, you confirm that you have a genuine interest in acquiring a business in Portugal. You agree not to share listing information or seller details with third parties.
termsPage.s4Body: Bottega does not guarantee that any introduction or listing will result in a completed transaction. We do not verify the accuracy of seller-provided financials. All buyers are advised to conduct independent due diligence before making any acquisition decision.
termsPage.s5Body: Bottega reserves the right to remove any listing that contains inaccurate, misleading, or inappropriate content, or that violates these terms. Business owners may request removal of their listing at any time by contacting privacy@bottegaventures.com.
termsPage.s6Body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Bottega is not liable for any loss or damage arising from the use of this platform, reliance on listing content, or the outcome of any transaction. Our total liability to any user shall not exceed the fees paid by that user in the 12 months preceding the claim.
termsPage.s7Body: These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.

process.heading: Three conversations, then a plan.
process.step1Body: A twenty minute call to understand the business, your timing, and what a good outcome looks like for you.
process.step2Body: We review the numbers, the operations, and the market, and share a realistic view of value and likely buyers.
process.step3Body: We approach the small set of buyers we already represent and run a discreet process through to closing.

faq.heading: What sellers ask us.
faq.a1: Our primary role is to find you the right buyer. We also connect sellers with our professional network including lawyers, accountants, and valuation specialists when needed.
faq.a2: We work with individual buyers and small investment groups looking for established, profitable businesses to acquire and operate. We qualify buyers before making any introduction.
faq.q3: Do I need a formal valuation before talking to you?
faq.a3: No. We can have an initial conversation based on what you know about your business. If a valuation becomes relevant, we can connect you with specialists in our network.
faq.a4: Every buyer signs a non-disclosure agreement before we share any details about your business. Nothing is disclosed without your explicit consent at each step.
faq.a5: Nothing upfront. Bottega charges 1% of the deal value, paid only if and when a transaction completes. If no deal is done, you owe nothing.
faq.q6: Why work with Bottega instead of a traditional broker?
faq.a6: Traditional brokers charge 3 to 5% plus a retainer fee and require exclusivity. We charge 1% and require no exclusivity, and only get paid when you do. We use AI to match your business to the right buyer faster, which means less time on the market and lower cost to you.
faq.q7: How long does the process take?
faq.a7: It varies by business and buyer. We do not rush deals. Our focus is on finding the right buyer at the right price, not the fastest close. Because we act in the seller's interest, we will not recommend accepting an offer that undervalues your business.
faq.q8: Am I committing to anything by getting in touch?
faq.a8: No. The first conversation is exploratory and there is no obligation to proceed at any stage.
faq.q9: I already work with a broker. Is that a problem?
faq.a9: No. We do not require exclusivity. If we have a buyer that fits, we are happy to work alongside your existing advisor.
faq.q10: I already have someone interested in buying my business. Can you still help?
faq.a10: Yes. We can help you structure the process, connect you with legal and financial advisors, and make sure you are protected throughout.
faq.a11: Not unless you decide to tell them. We run a quiet process and approach only the buyers we already represent. No public listings, no wide email blasts.
